errors.description: The tab extends past the centre front by roughly one and a quarter times the waistband depth; the brief derived about one and a half from the drawing. The squared end and both fastenings are unaffected.
errors.expected: tab extension about one and a half times the waistband depth

notes:
ADVERSARIAL READ vs /images/blueprints/factory/83fb9e94e989__342A__Square_hook_btn.png.

WHAT THE DRAWING SPECIFIES: a close view of the waistband closure with the fly opened out. Red marks appear in two places: on the under-band a red ring plus a red bar, and on the extension tab a red-outlined RECTANGLE containing a red ring and a red bar. Read together: a squared extension tab carrying a hook and a button, engaging a bar and a buttonhole on the under-band. The red rectangle's corners are square, which is the option's name.

NOTE ON THE OPTION ID: the id string is 'ext-curved' but both the label ('Square, Hook & Button') and the drawing specify a SQUARE end. The drawing is the authority and the render follows it; the id is legacy and does not describe the geometry.

ATTEMPTED REJECTIONS THAT FAILED:
(1) Rounded or curved tab end, which the stale option id would have suggested? No — the tab terminates in a clean vertical squared edge with right-angled corners.
(2) Only one fastening, which would collapse this into a hook-only or button-only sibling? No — a metal hook bar, a worked buttonhole and a button are all three present on the closure.
(3) A belt, belt loops through the closure, or side adjusters imported from a neighbouring waistband option? None in frame.
(4) Framing failure — legs, model or jacket intruding, which was the specific risk called out for this option? No. The crop is tight to the waistband closure; only a sliver of shirt shows above it.
(5) Annotation traced? No red anywhere; the hardware is metal and the button is tonal horn.
(6) Wrong face? Trouser front waistband closure, correct.

No critical or major findings.
